title: Verify nondefault workbench parameter parity
changes: Add a cross-channel parser matrix for nondefault workbench values, valid bounds and selected out-of-range refusals.
validation: Windows GNU test build passed; Wine passed the new matrix and all eight workbench tests. Seven direct forms produced identical typed actions across menu drafts, console and local-control parsers; six out-of-range cases were refused across all three, without filesystem artifacts.
limitations: Parser-level checks do not execute every parameter combination. Issue-profile resolution, wider runtime outcomes, native Windows, physical input and complete DBG2-13 parity remain outside this matrix.
